prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: A text description of the desired image

quality.title: quality
quality.description: The quality of the generated image. Higher quality takes longer and costs more.

svg_model.title: svg_model
svg_model.description: SVG only. The model that traces the generated image into vector paths. gpt-6-astra and gpt-5.5 trace most carefully but are slower and cost more, and very detailed scenes can time out. Ignored for other formats.

background.title: background
background.description: Set whether the background is transparent or opaque or choose automatically

complexity.title: complexity
complexity.description: How much the model plans before rendering. Higher complexity helps with dense text and complex layouts but can increase latency.

frame_count.title: Frame Count
frame_count.description: Number of frames in a GIF. Ignored for other formats. For GIFs, named aspect ratios map to smaller frame sizes (1:1 is 512x512) because all frames share one image budget.

aspect_ratio.title: aspect_ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The size of the generated image. Use 'auto' to let the model pick. Sizes above 2560x1440 are experimental and may give more variable results.

input_images.title: Input Images
input_images.description: A list of images to use as input for the generation

output_format.title: output_format
output_format.description: Output format. 'gif' returns an animated GIF. 'svg' returns a vector image and works only for generation with one image.

openai_api_key.title: Openai Api Key
openai_api_key.description: Your OpenAI API key (optional - uses proxy if not provided)

frame_duration_ms.title: Frame Duration Ms
frame_duration_ms.description: How long each GIF frame shows, in milliseconds, rounded to 10 ms. Ignored for other formats.
